calculate_metrics: calculate recall, ndcg, and error rate metrics for GenRec predicted token sequences against ground truth labels
calculate_pos_index: calculate the position index of ground truth items within predicted token sequences for ranking evaluation
recall_at_k: compute the recall at k metric from a boolean position index tensor for recommendation evaluation
ndcg_at_k: compute the normalized discounted cumulative gain at k from a position index tensor for ranking quality
err_at_k: calculate the percentage of illegal predictions among the top k generated token sequences
